_source: Blueprint D1. requiredEvidence = must all be selected (and known) to confirm; supportingEvidence = may also be selected without breaking the deduction. wrongConclusions are NOT in the blueprint (added by Nav's Claude for the deduction screen; proofread).

deductions.question: Who activated the village bell at 2:17?
deductions.requiredDescription: Untouched bell rope; identical 2:17 timestamps; lantern resonance mark.
deductions.conclusion: The Echo Lantern triggered the bell through the underground network. No person rang it.
wrongConclusions: Mira rang the bell herself to warn the village.
A villager pulled the rope and fled before anyone saw.
deductions.unlockText: Unlock clock-tower basement and first corrected timeline note.
deductions.reaction: The bell was never the warning. It was the broadcast.

deductions.question: Why do witness memories show different times?
deductions.requiredDescription: Mira's stopped clock; school stopwatch; Arun's later timestamp.
deductions.conclusion: 2:17 is the system freeze. Events continued after the clocks stopped.
wrongConclusions: The clocks were simply broken. Nothing happened after 2:17.
The later entry is a mistake. Every clock was right.
deductions.reaction: If time was edited, someone edited it on purpose.

deductions.question: Who is the fourth figure?
deductions.requiredDescription: Coat silhouette; lantern staff; apprentice sketch.
deductions.conclusion: The recurring figure is Elias Vane, the former Veyra apprentice.
wrongConclusions: The figure was a stranger passing through Veyra.
The figure was Arun, carrying lanterns down to the river.
deductions.reaction: I knew that shape. I just did not know I knew it.

deductions.question: Why did the river disappear?
deductions.requiredDescription: Dry riverbed; emergency sluice; river ledger.
deductions.conclusion: The river was diverted underground during the lantern overload.
wrongConclusions: A long drought dried the river weeks before.
The villagers dammed the river upstream.
deductions.reaction: The river did not vanish. It was sent somewhere.

deductions.question: When did Arun actually see the figure?
deductions.requiredDescription: 2:31 pocket watch; 2:17 village clock; figure sighting.
deductions.conclusion: The night continued after 2:17, proving the village timeline is false.
wrongConclusions: Arun saw the figure before the clocks stopped.
Arun's watch ran fast. He saw nothing after 2:17.
deductions.reaction: The night kept moving after the clocks stopped.

deductions.question: Who was Elias carrying to the lantern chamber?
deductions.requiredDescription: Silver hairclip; clinic card; figure silhouette.
deductions.conclusion: Nia was the child in Elias's arms. The experiment was meant to preserve her mind.
wrongConclusions: A stranger's child, carried away from the flood.
One of Mira's pupils, fleeing the bell.
deductions.unlockText: Unlock Nia's medical record and motive clue.
deductions.reaction: I was not rescuing the village. I was taking someone to the machine.

deductions.question: What can the Echo Lantern actually do?
deductions.requiredDescription: Technical schematic; memory spool; anchor notation.
deductions.conclusion: It can extract, store and transfer memories, and bind multiple minds as anchors.
wrongConclusions: It is only a lamp for reading old records.
It can show memories, but it can never take them.
deductions.reaction: I knew what it did. I had forgotten what it could cost.

deductions.question: Why were the memories altered?
deductions.requiredDescription: Edited ledger; overwritten notes; Elias annotations.
deductions.conclusion: Elias triggered a second pulse to erase his role and hide the experiment.
wrongConclusions: Ten years of grief wore the memories away.
Leela edited the records to hide her own mistake.
deductions.reaction: The missing pieces were not missing. I removed them.

deductions.question: What caused the mass disappearance?
deductions.requiredDescription: Master console; Nia monitor; village network map.
deductions.conclusion: Elias activated the network to save Nia, trapping villagers and creating the ghost loops.
wrongConclusions: A storm struck the tower and overloaded the network.
Leela connected every node and lost control.
deductions.reaction: The case stopped being about what happened to them. It became about what I did.
